description: Defines the HttpResponseInfo class and related enums and data structures used for representing HTTP response metadata in the Chromium project.

classes.name: HttpResponseInfo
classes.description: Represents detailed information about an HTTP response, including headers, connection info, cache status, SSL info, and other metadata.

methods.name: InitFromPickle
methods.description: Initializes the object from a serialized pickle representation.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Serializes the response info into a pickle.

methods.name: DidUseQuic
methods.description: Returns true if QUIC was used for the response.

methods.name: ConnectionInfoToCoarse
methods.description: Converts detailed connection info to a coarse category.

methods.name: ConnectionInfoToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the connection info enum.
